reader.requirement: At --std 85, the Sequential I-O SAME clause (§1985:VII.2.13) must hold for relative files: operands are files of this program's FILE-CONTROL and not external, a file in at most one SAME AREA and one SAME RECORD AREA clause, a SAME AREA group wholly inside any SAME RECORD AREA it shares a file with, mixed organizations and access modes allowed, and a SAME RECORD AREA record is one area aligned leftmost for every open output file and the most recently read input file.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 the report-file row admits SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA; relative (Other-kind) files take the same row at every edition

reader.edition-search: grep Edition.Edition.Year|DialectLevel over FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs: the only edition axis is the report-file row of SameOccurrenceRule; the sharing itself (LinkSameRecordArea's implicit redefinition) is edition-free.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: for relative files the SAME rules and the shared record area are the same at 85 and 2023 (only report files differ)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers SAME AREA plus SAME RECORD AREA on three relative files; it does not exercise the SR1/SR2/SR3a/SR3b/SR3c refusals, mixed organizations (SR4), variable-length records, or the most-recently-read rule across organizations
